en: Vintage Romanian postcard showing the ornate interior of Sala Unirii (Union Hall) in the Alba Iulia citadel: a long arched hall with chandeliers, stucco decorations, marble columns and display tables; flags are visible along the right wall. The reverse has Romanian printed captioning, a brown 55 B Posta Romana stamp, a Zlatna (Alba) postmark, and a handwritten message addressed to Bucharest.
